title: Cup-ring consistency test: image prompts and inspection sheet
purpose: Source package for a two-frame consistency experiment. Provides the two image prompts and a structured observation sheet for recording whether LTX-generated frames are consistent enough to support any transition. This is the prerequisite check before the cut-vs-crossfade comparison can be interpreted.
